summary: End-to-end test of the new Apple-style Admin Dashboard. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass against the live preview backend, covering super-admin & legacy-admin login, soft-block flow (block → 403 'Account ist deaktiviert' → unblock), guards (cannot block super-admin or self), admin password reset for users (with 8-char min validation), admin self-password change (wrong current → 401, valid → 200), /admin/users shape (subscription, company_name, role, active, no _id), /admin/users/{id}/contracts (no _id, no pdf_b64), /admin/comparisons, /admin/url-stats (4 windows + now), /admin/stats, and /admin/contracts/{id}/pdf (StreamingResponse, application/pdf magic bytes verified). Authorization test confirms non-admin tokens get 401/403 on every /admin/* endpoint. Frontend: super-admin login redirects to /admin, AdminLayout sidebar shows Übersicht/Nutzer/Vergleiche/URL-Statistik/Einstellungen; /admin/users renders 4 accounts with Aktiv/Plan badges and working Passwort/Sperren buttons (modal opens); /admin/comparisons lists vehicles with sources; /admin/urls shows 4 cards (Heute/24 Std/7 Tage/Gesamt) plus the 'Live-Aktualisierung alle 60 Sekunden' indicator; /admin/settings exposes the self-password form; /admin/users/{id} (UserDetail) renders profile + read-only Verträge list; non-admin dealer navigating to /admin is correctly redirected to /login?next=%2Fadmin.

issues: No data-testid attributes on per-user 'Passwort'/'Sperren'/'Entsperren' buttons or the search input — tests had to fall back to text selectors. Add testids like user-row-{id}, user-pw-btn-{id}, user-toggle-active-btn-{id} for stable automation.
Sidebar label is 'URL-Statistik' but the second card is rendered as '24 Std' (not '24h' as in the spec) — only cosmetic; matches the design but worth noting.

action_items: (Low) Add data-testid attributes throughout the admin_v2 pages for stable E2E (rows, action buttons, modal inputs).
(Low) Consider also blocking demote-to-non-admin / preventing role downgrade of super-admin in PUT /api/admin/users/{id} (currently only the soft-block endpoint guards super_admin).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2526 lines — well past the 700 LoC threshold. Continue splitting into routers (admin, auth, dealer, drivers, payments, contracts, listings).
POST /admin/users/{id}/active correctly invalidates current_session_id when blocking. Good.
POST /admin/users/{id}/password also invalidates the user's session — the active dealer is force-logged-out as expected. Good.
/admin/users returns a plain list (not wrapped) — Users.jsx defensively handles both shapes via `data.users || data || []`. Fine.
/admin/url-stats: `d['autoscout'] = d.pop('autoscout') + d.pop('autoscout24')` works because pop returns the values before re-insert; readability could improve with a temp var.

PUT /api/admin/users/{id} (legacy generic update) does NOT guard against blocking super-admin or self. The new dedicated /active endpoint guards both, but a malicious admin could still call PUT with {active:false} on a super-admin/themselves. Recommend hardening the legacy route too.

Admin-self password change: response invalidates ALL prior sessions of the admin (since the next /me-style call re-issues session_id), which is why my pytest had to re-login between tests — expected, but worth a test fixture caveat.
Frontend /admin/comparisons: clicking a row expands users + sources (verified 1 BMW 325 row visible).

Legacy admin: <ADMIN_EMAIL> / <ADMIN_PASSWORD> (verified, password is restored to original by the test_change_then_change_back test). seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates one test dealer (TEST Dash Co {suffix}). Frontend non-admin redirect test creates one ephemeral dealer nonadmin_{ts}@example.com / TestPass123. None are torn down — minor data accumulation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_dashboard.py — 19 tests, all passing. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep '^REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=' /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2-) pytest backend/tests/test_admin_dashboard.py -v. The frontend routes that exist (verified): /admin, /admin/users, /admin/users/{id}, /admin/comparisons, /admin/urls, /admin/settings (note the path is /admin/urls not /admin/url-stats). admin_v2 components have NO data-testid attrs — use text selectors. Login form has data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit. The /api/admin/users endpoint returns a plain list (not wrapped); Users.jsx already handles both shapes. Self-password change invalidates the prior bearer token on next state-changing call (single-session guard) — fixtures must re-login if a test mutates the admin's password.
